request.style: English, female solo voice with gospel choir, acoustic piano, upright bass, drums, tambourine, warm and solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Moses wrote the song that day
He taught the people what to say
The Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun
Be strong and brave, the work is done
I will bring them into the land
I swore to give with my own hand
I myself shall be with you there
No fear shall cloud your solemn care

[Chorus]
Take this Book of the Law
Place it by the ark forever
It stands as a witness against you
For I know your hearts are few
Rebellious and stiff-necked is your way
Even now in my life today

[Verse]
When the writing was finished completely
From the first verse to the final beat
He gave the command to the Levite
Who carries the ark of God's light
Place it beside the covenant seat
There it will remain in the street
A witness against you, the people see
How much more when I am free

[Chorus]
Take this Book of the Law
Place it by the ark forever
It stands as a witness against you
For I know your hearts are few
Rebellious and stiff-necked is your way
Even now in my life today

[Bridge]
Assemble before me all the elders
With the officials and tribal leaders
So I may speak these words aloud
And call heaven and earth to crowd
To testify against your rebellion
Before my death and final fall

[Verse]
I know you will become corrupt
And turn from the path you must
In days to come disaster will come
Because you will do evil, hum
Evil in the sight of the Lord
And anger Him with what you form

[Chorus]
Take this Book of the Law
Place it by the ark forever
It stands as a witness against you
For I know your hearts are few
Rebellious and stiff-necked is your way
Even now in my life today

[Outro]
Moses recited the song then
From the beginning to the end
